statement: Claire has tutored my nine year old daughter in Maths since the beginning of this year. More recently she has also been tutoring her in English due to the improvements in both confidence and academic progress we have noticed. Claire has not only demonstrated excellent teaching skills, patience and professionalism, but a genuine passion and commitment to her success. She creates a positive and supportive learning environment and adapts her approach to suit my daughter’s individual needs and learning style. She explains concepts clearly, encourages independent and creative thinking and, through taking the time to understand her interests and passion points, tailors learning to approach with greater enthusiasm to support her to stay engaged.
